title: setDesiredAPY commit branch does not clear pendingAPYBps / pendingAPYBlockNumber, leaving inert-but-misleading view state
rootCause: The commit branch clears `apySetInProgress` but leaves `pendingAPYBps`/`pendingAPYBlockNumber` populated with the just-committed values. `getPendingAPYInfo()` therefore reports stale values until the next preview overwrites them.
impactSummary: Off-chain integrator confusion. No fund loss, no protocol-state corruption. Strictly QA.
preservedDetails: CODE-010 carries the full walkthrough. Distinct from DEDUP-010 (ECON-004 MEV failure of the two-step gate) — DEDUP-010 is about economics, DEDUP-016 is about state hygiene.
remediation: Add `pendingAPYBps = 0; pendingAPYBlockNumber = 0;` at the end of the commit branch.
relatedFindings: DEDUP-010 (sister finding on the same function)
